# Aicardly

> Aicardly is an AI-powered digital business card platform built and operated by Webkik Services, Delhi, India. Professionals create a digital business card in under 60 seconds and share it with a QR code, an NFC tap, or a custom public link (aicardly.com/yourname). Each card can include an AI chat assistant that greets visitors, answers questions, and captures leads 24/7. Aicardly also offers premium metal NFC business cards linked to the digital card. Visitors do not need to install any app. It is free to start.

Aicardly is built for founders, consultants, real estate agents, creators, coaches, and agencies.

## Key facts

- Product type: digital business card platform (SaaS) plus physical metal NFC business cards
- Sharing methods: QR code, NFC tap, custom link, WhatsApp quick connect
- AI feature: configurable AI persona and chat widget on every card
- Analytics: profile views, link taps, and engagement dashboard
- Pricing: free to start; premium metal NFC cards are sold separately
- Company: Webkik Services, WZ-52, 2nd Floor, Above Shubham Band, Tagore Garden, Delhi - 110027, India
- Contact: supportaicardly@gmail.com, +91-9868698698

- [Pricing](https://aicardly.com/pricing): Plans in INR, monthly or yearly, with a full feature comparison
- [Metal NFC Business Card](https://aicardly.com/metal-nfc-card): Premium stainless steel NFC cards with logo and name engraving, linked to your digital card
- [Create your card](https://aicardly.com/register): Sign up free and make your AI digital business card
- [FAQs](https://aicardly.com/faqs): Answers about digital business cards, NFC, QR codes, and the AI chat widget
